venue.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete the venue {name}?
venue.listDescription: Buildings and sites with items to book.
venue.emptyDescription: Create your first venue to get started.
venue.notFound: The venue does not exist or is archived.
venue.createDescription: Enter details about the venue. You can add items afterwards.
venue.itemsEmpty: No items at this venue yet.

item.listDescription: What you sell and book, e.g. rooms, dishes and equipment. The type decides which fields an item has.
item.createDescription: Pick a type and fill in the details.
item.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the item {name}?
item.emptyDescription: Create an item type under Types, then add items.
item.noTypes: There are no item types yet. Create a type first.
item.savePackageDescription: Pick a package type and its parts. The package is shown only for this customer; the catalog is unchanged.
item.packagesEmpty: No packages for this customer yet.
item.packagesNoTypes: There is no item type with parts (COMPOSABLE) yet. Create one under Types first.
item.setupsHint: Capacity, max number of people, per setup. Leave empty for setups that are not used.
item.noSetups: There are no setups. Create them under Setups.

components.hint: The items this item contains, with quantity and timing relative to its start.

customer.listDescription: The companies, agencies, associations and people that buy from you. The type decides which fields a customer has.
customer.createDescription: Pick a type and fill in the details.
customer.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the customer {name}? Archive its contact persons first.
customer.archiveBlocked: This customer has {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} that {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not archived. The customer cannot be archived while {count, plural, one {it remains} other {they remain}}.
customer.archiveBookings: Also archive {count, plural, one {the booking} other {all # bookings}} for this customer
customer.archivedWithBookings: The customer and {count, plural, one {# booking} other {# bookings}} have been archived.
customer.noTypes: There are no customer types yet. Create a type first.

contact.createDescription: Pick a type and fill in the details.
contact.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the contact person {name}?
contact.archived: The contact person has been archived.
contact.created: The contact person has been added.
contact.updated: The contact person has been updated.
contact.noTypes: There are no contact types yet. Create one under Types first.

bookingSeries.listDescription: Recurring bookings, e.g. a meeting room on the first Tuesday of every month. Every occurrence is an ordinary booking.
bookingSeries.createDescription: Pick a type, the customer, the recurrence and the room. Occurrences are created up to 12 months or 52 times ahead, each in the default tentative status.
bookingSeries.emptyDescription: Create a series for a customer who books the same thing regularly.
bookingSeries.clashNotice: {count, plural, one {# occurrence clashes} other {# occurrences clash}} with another booking or a blocked time. It is created without the room; pick another room or time for it.
bookingSeries.truncated: The rule continues after the last occurrence shown; later occurrences are created further on.

fields.ruleHint: RRULE, e.g. FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=1TU;COUNT=10 (first Tuesday of the month, 10 times) or FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH;UNTIL=20270630.

bookingSeries.itemsTaken: The room is already taken at that time. Pick another room or time.
bookingSeries.editOccurrenceDescription: Move the occurrence to another time or room. "This and following" moves every later occurrence by the same amount and changes the series going forward.
bookingSeries.cancelSeriesDescription: Every upcoming occurrence is cancelled with the reason and its room is released. Occurrences that have already started or ended are not changed.

booking.listDescription: Conferences and events with customer, time, headcount, status and owners. The type decides which fields a booking has.
booking.createDescription: Pick a type, the customer and the time. The booking starts in the default tentative status.
booking.editDescription: Change customer, time, headcount and the type's fields. The status and the owners are changed separately.
booking.assignDescription: Pick the salesperson and the coordinator among the members.
booking.coordinatorRequired: A confirmed booking needs a coordinator.
booking.changeStatusDescription: Move the booking to one of the statuses the organization allows from its current status. A cancellation needs a reason and releases the booking's rooms and resources.
booking.phaseRuleRefused: The change breaks a booking rule: confirmed and completed bookings need a coordinator, and a booking can be completed only after it has ended.
booking.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the cancellation.
booking.noTypes: There are no booking types yet. Create a type first.

inquiry.listDescription: Requests from customers on their way to a quote and a booking. Each inquiry moves NEW → QUALIFIED → QUOTED → WON, or is marked lost with a reason.
inquiry.title: Inquiry from {customer}
inquiry.createDescription: Pick a type and the customer. The inquiry starts as new.
inquiry.editDescription: Change customer, contact, dates, quantity, budget and the type's fields. The status and the salesperson are changed separately.
inquiry.assignDescription: Pick the salesperson among the members.
inquiry.ownerRequired: A qualified inquiry needs a salesperson.
inquiry.qualifyDescription: A qualified inquiry needs a salesperson. Pick one among the members.
inquiry.markLostDescription: Say why the inquiry was lost. A lost inquiry cannot be reopened.
inquiry.markedLost: The inquiry has been marked as lost.
inquiry.noTypes: There are no inquiry types yet. Create a type first.

occupancy.formDescription: Block the item for maintenance or internal use. Bookings and setup time cannot overlap a block.
occupancy.archiveConfirm: Do you want to release the block so the item can be booked again?
occupancy.empty: The item is not occupied from now on.
occupancy.overlap: The item is already occupied during this period.

programItem.createDescription: Add a row to the booking's run schedule. With a room it is occupied for the period, plus the setup's changeover time.
programItem.editDescription: Change time, place, quantity or note. Moving it moves the occupancy.
programItem.archiveConfirm: Do you want to remove "{name}" from the program? The room is released.
programItem.archived: The program item has been removed.
programItem.created: The program item has been added.
programItem.updated: The program item has been updated.
programItem.assignDescription: The responsible person must be a member of the organization.
programItem.assigned: The responsible person has been changed.
programItem.empty: The booking has no program items yet.
programItem.occupied: The room is already occupied during this period or its changeover time.

entityType.listDescription: Types decide which fields and behaviours items, customers and bookings have in your organization.
entityType.createDescription: Choose what the type is for and name it.
entityType.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the type {name}? This is refused while it is in use.
entityType.emptyDescription: Create a type, e.g. Conference room or Dish, and add its fields.
entityType.imported: {created, plural, one {# type} other {# types}} created, {skipped} already existed.
entityType.behavioursHint: Behaviours switch on general features for items of the type. A behaviour cannot be switched off while items have data for it.

behaviourHints.BOOKABLE: Occupies time and has a default length.

fieldDefinition.createDescription: The field appears on every record of the type.
fieldDefinition.editDescription: Change the field. The value type cannot change once there are values.
fieldDefinition.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the field {name}?
fieldDefinition.noLists: There are no lists. Create one under Lists.

vocabulary.listDescription: Your own word lists, e.g. allergens or dress code, that fields and requirements point to.
vocabulary.createDescription: Name the list and optionally add the first values.
vocabulary.editDescription: Change the name of the list.
vocabulary.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the list {name}? This is refused while a field uses it.
vocabulary.emptyDescription: Create a list or import the EU's 14 allergens.

value.heading: List values
value.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the value {name}?
value.name: Value

setup.listDescription: How a space can be set up, e.g. Cinema, U-shape or Mingle, and how long the changeover takes.
setup.createDescription: Name the setup and enter the changeover time.
setup.editDescription: Change the name and changeover time.
setup.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the setup {name}?
setup.emptyDescription: Create setups such as Cinema, U-shape and Mingle.

sheetDefinition.listDescription: Your own sheets, e.g. Kitchen order or Brewing order: which item types, fields and lists' requirements each includes, and which role it goes to.
sheetDefinition.createDescription: Name the sheet, choose what it includes and who receives it.
sheetDefinition.editDescription: Change the name, what the sheet includes or who receives it.
sheetDefinition.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the sheet {name}?
sheetDefinition.emptyDescription: Create sheets such as Kitchen order or Brewing order.

hints.entityTypeIds: Items of these types appear on the sheet.
hints.vocabularyIds: Requirements from these lists are counted on the sheet.

none.entityTypeIds: There are no item types. Create them under Types.
none.fieldIds: Choose item types with fields first.
none.vocabularyIds: There are no lists. Create them under Lists.

bookingStatus.listDescription: Your own statuses for bookings. Each belongs to a fixed phase that decides what the system allows; the first status of a phase is its default.
bookingStatus.createDescription: Name the status, pick a color and the phase it belongs to.
bookingStatus.editDescription: Change the name and color. The phase cannot be changed.
bookingStatus.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the status {name}? Its transitions are removed.
bookingStatus.emptyDescription: Import the template to get started.
bookingStatus.transitionsDescription: Choose which statuses a booking with the status {name} may move to.
bookingStatus.noTargets: There are no other statuses to move to.
